'''Daniel Marshall''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2000 Austin tournament]] on 25 March 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB]], according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d389">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-austin-tx-3-25-000-test-of-the-revod389/ austin-tx-3-25-000-test-of-the-revo], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 26 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-austin-tx-3-25-000-test-of-the-revod389/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
